StringColumn.Name: Direction
StringColumn.Caption: Direction
StringColumn.FullDescription: LOAD = send manifest for all shipments expected to be loaded at the port. DISCHARGE = send manifest for all shipments expected to be discharged at the port.

StringColumn.Name: Port
StringColumn.Caption: Port
StringColumn.FullDescription:
The message will be delivered to the port authority for this port.
If you expected to find a port that is not in this list then check that it is entered on the schedule as a load or discharge port and that the port has been configured correctly in the registry:
Liner & Agency -> Port Authority -> Settings.

StringColumn.Name: MessageType
StringColumn.Caption: Message Type
StringColumn.FullDescription: The type of message to send.

GuidColumn.Name: CTO
GuidColumn.Caption: CTO
GuidColumn.FullDescription: Is the CTO entered against the selected load or discharge port.

BoolColumn.Name: DeliverTo3rdParty
BoolColumn.Caption: Deliver one off message to 3rd party.
BoolColumn.FullDescription: Tick this check box to enable overriding delivery details. Messages delivered in this way will not be tracked.

StringColumn.Name: Version
StringColumn.Caption: Version
StringColumn.FullDescription: The message format version to use when generating the message.

StringColumn.Name: SenderId
StringColumn.Caption: Sender ID
StringColumn.FullDescription: The sender id to use when generating the message.

StringColumn.Name: RecipientId
StringColumn.Caption: Recipient ID
StringColumn.FullDescription: The recipient id to use when generating the message.

StringColumn.Name: EmailAddress
StringColumn.Caption: Email Address
StringColumn.FullDescription: The email address to which the generated message should be sent.
